lines.serbian: Dejanov stari računar je veoma spor.
lines.croatian: Dejanovo staro računalo je vrlo sporo.
lines.english: Dejan's old computer is very slow.

lines.serbian: Treba mu pet minuta samo da se uključi.
lines.croatian: Treba mu pet minuta samo da se uključi.
lines.english: It takes five minutes just to turn on.

lines.serbian: U subotu Dejan ide u prodavnicu računara.
lines.croatian: U subotu Dejan ide u trgovinu računalima.
lines.english: On Saturday Dejan goes to a computer shop.
"What do you need?" asks the salesman.

lines.serbian: – Hoću bolji računar. Brži, sa velikim ekranom.
lines.croatian: – Želim bolje računalo. Brže, s velikim ekranom.
lines.english: "I want a better computer. Faster, with a big screen."
The salesman points to a black laptop.

lines.serbian: – Ovaj je veoma brz i ima mnogo memorije.
lines.croatian: – Ovaj je vrlo brz i ima puno memorije.
lines.english: "This one is very fast and has lots of memory."

lines.serbian: – Imamo ovaj. Osamsto evra, a skoro je isti.
lines.croatian: – Imamo ovaj. Osamsto eura, a gotovo je isti.
lines.english: "We have this one. Eight hundred euros, and it's almost the same."

lines.serbian: Dejan ga kupuje i srećan ide kući.
lines.croatian: Dejan ga kupuje i sretan ide kući.
lines.english: Dejan buys it and goes home happy.

lines.serbian: Uključuje ga. Za pet sekundi je spreman.
lines.croatian: Uključuje ga. Za pet sekundi je spreman.
lines.english: He turns it on. It's ready in five seconds.

lines.serbian: Zatim pokušava da otvori svoje stare slike.
lines.croatian: Zatim pokušava otvoriti svoje stare slike.
lines.english: Then he tries to open his old photos.

lines.serbian: Nema ih. Sve su na starom računaru.
lines.croatian: Nema ih. Sve su na starom računalu.
lines.english: They aren't there. They're all on the old computer.

lines.serbian: Dejan uključuje stari računar i čeka.
lines.croatian: Dejan uključuje staro računalo i čeka.
lines.english: Dejan turns on the old computer and waits.
